segments.sn46.16:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
segments.sn46.16:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
segments.sn46.16:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā mahācundo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ mahācundaṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.sn46.16:2.1: “Sattime, bhante, bojjhaṅgā bhagavatā sammadakkhātā bhāvitā bahulīkatā abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattanti.
segments.sn46.16:2.3: Satisambojjhaṅgo kho, bhante, bhagavatā sammadakkhāto bhāvito bahulīkato abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati … pe … upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo kho, bhante, bhagavatā sammadakkhāto bhāvito bahulīkato abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
segments.sn46.16:2.4: Ime kho, bhante, satta bojjhaṅgā bhagavatā sammadakkhātā bhāvitā bahulīkatā abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattantī”ti.
segments.sn46.16:3.4: Tathāpahīno ca bhagavato so ābādho ahosīti.

lines: 195-201. Catutthe tathā pahīno cāyasmato mahākassapassa so ābādho ahosīti therassa kira imaṃ bojjhaṅgabhāvanaṃ sādhukaṃ suṇantassa etadahosi “mayhaṃ pabbajitadivasato sattame divase saccāni paṭivijjhantassa ime bojjhaṅgā pātubhūtā”ti.
Athassa “niyyānikaṃ vata satthusāsanan”ti cintayato lohitaṃ pasīdi, upādārūpaṃ visuddhaṃ ahosi, pokkharapatte patitaudakabindu viya sarīrato rogo vinivattitvā gato.
Tena vuttaṃ “tathā pahīno cāyasmato mahākassapassa so ābādho ahosī”ti.
Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi janānaṃ pabbatapāde pupphitavisarukkhavātasamphassena uppanno mandasītajaro ābādhoti veditabbo.
Eseva nayo pāḷito atthato ca catutthena pañcamachaṭṭhānaṃ samānattā.
